target.statement: Dynamic-I2V achieves a DIVE Dynamic Range (DR) score of 45.77, a 42.5% improvement over CogVideoX-I2V-5B.
target.dataset: VBench-I2V test set (355 image-text pairs) evaluated with DIVE

compute.basis: Reproducing the headline DIVE DR score requires fine-tuning CogVideoX-I2V-5B with Qwen2VL-2B on 123k OpenVid videos, reported as ~38 h/epoch on 16 GPUs, then running DIVE evaluation with GPT-4o; no code or trained model is released.

blockers: No code release or model checkpoint
Requires 16 GPUs for fine-tuning (~608 GPU-hours per epoch)
DIVE evaluation uses GPT-4o, a closed-source API
Filtered 123k OpenVid subset and prompt details are not released
5B video diffusion model cannot be trained/evaluated on an 8-core CPU laptop within hours
title: Dynamic-I2V: Exploring Image-to-Video Generation Models via Multimodal LLM
